_comment: The extension engine the app downloads on first use (Admin -> Extensions). Built by engine/pack.mjs and published by .github/workflows/engine-pack.yml on the PRERELEASE tag below, so electron-updater never mistakes it for an app release. sha256 + bytes are filled in after that workflow publishes the packs; while a pack's sha256 is null the app says the download is not available yet and never fetches anything. A new pack (a new Suwayomi pin, or a changed shim) is a new tag and new hashes here.
